plugin.name: FHX
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Repeatedly cast 'incomp' on self or others until healed
plugin.description:
FHX - repeatedly casts incomplete healing until the target is healed, you run low on mana, or you enter combat.
fhx self-heal (cast 'c incomp' on yourself) fhx <player> heal another player ('c incomp <player>') fhx low heal whoever in the room is lowest on HP - you included (only counts people missing more than 4000 hp) fhx stop stop healing immediately
hx cast once on yourself (no repeating) hx <player> cast once on another player hx low cast once on whoever is lowest on HP - you included (only counts people missing more than 4000 hp)
Any of the above take a count: 'hx low x3', 'fhx low 2'.
fhx queue show what's waiting ('fhx stop' empties it) fhx silent hide the cast-by-cast lines (on/off too) fhx time which plugins are using the most client time fhx cooldown <n> seconds auto waits between runs fhx burst <n> most casts auto may send after one fight (default 3) fhx auto toggle auto-heal: heals after every fight, until done (switches itself off when you leave the area) fhx auto on / fhx auto off set it explicitly fhx auto leader toggle auto onto the group leader only (on/off too)
fhx regen switch the spell to regeneration (c regen) fhx incomp switch the spell back to incomplete healing (c incomp) fhx ignore add <player> never let 'fhx low' target <player> fhx ignore remove <player> allow 'fhx low' to target <player> again fhx ignore list show the current ignore list fhx ignore clear empty the ignore list fhx help show the help screen
Stops automatically on: - "You are almost fully healed." (self) - "<player> is almost fully healed." (other) - "<player> is already fully healed." (other) - "Your magic is wasted." (target already full) - "You don't have enough mana to cast 'incomplete healing'." - "You can't concentrate enough to cast 'incomplete healing'." - you enter combat (GMCP char.status.state)
'fhx low' uses GMCP group data, so you must be grouped with the target. You are a candidate too: if you're the lowest one in the room it heals you, and if you're not grouped at all it falls back to your own HP.
Pets and charmed mobs in the group are never targeted - they're identified by the GMCP 'qs' field (3 = the group member is a mob, not a player), so a pet golem in the room can't soak up your heals. It locks onto one target and will not jump to whoever later becomes the lowest - run it again to retarget.
The 'hx' commands mirror the 'fhx' ones but send exactly one cast and then stop - no pacing, no watchdog, nothing to stop.
AUTO LEADER: with 'fhx auto leader' on, auto stops picking the lowest and watches the group leader instead - it queues a heal for them only when they're down more than 4000 HP. Everything else about auto is unchanged, and your own typed commands are never affected by this toggle.
STAYING OUT OF YOUR WAY: auto sends one cast at a time and never adds to the queue while anything is still waiting there, so it cannot put your commands behind a pile of its own. A cooldown limits how often it engages.
AUTO SWITCHES OFF WHEN YOU LEAVE: turning auto on remembers the area you were in (GMCP room.info 'zone'). Walk, recall or portal into a different area and auto turns itself off, so it never follows you somewhere you didn't want it running. Exception: The Titans' Keep ('titan') and Transcendence ('transcend') count as one place, so crossing between them leaves auto running.
AUTO: with 'fhx auto' on, 'hx low' is queued when combat ends. It sends at most 'fhx burst' casts (3 by default) for that fight, one at a time, and stops early once nobody is missing more than the player threshold - or, in leader mode, once the leader is back above the leader threshold. It never adds to the queue while anything is still waiting there, so auto can never be more than one command deep and you are never more than a burst behind. A run also stops early if you run out of mana, can't concentrate, or a new fight starts, and picks up when that fight ends. Commands you type by hand are not capped. The setting persists between sessions.
SILENT: 'fhx silent' hides the running commentary - the cast-by-cast lines, queue progress and auto's chatter. Anything you typed a command to see still prints, as do spell/threshold/mode changes and auto switching itself on or off (including running out of mana or leaving the area).
QUEUE: every fhx/hx command becomes a queue item and they run strictly in order, one at a time. If you're in combat (or in a note, at a pager prompt, or asleep) they wait instead of firing, and start on their own once you're free again. A repeating 'fhx' item holds the queue until it finishes, so 'fhx' then 'fhx low' self-heals first and heals the lowest afterwards. 'low' is resolved when the item actually runs, so 'hx low x3' re-checks who the lowest person in the room is before each cast.

trigger.name: fhx_heal_tick
trigger.match: You are .* healed by your magic touch\.

trigger.name: fhx_other_heal_tick
trigger.match: (\w+) is .* healed by your magic touch\.

trigger.name: fhx_regen_self_tick
trigger.match: A great healing power courses through your veins leaving you greatly regenerated\.

trigger.name: fhx_regen_other_tick
trigger.match: A great healing power courses through the veins of (\w+) leaving \w+ greatly regenerated\.

trigger.name: fhx_no_mana
trigger.match: You don't have enough mana to cast 'incomplete healing'\.

trigger.name: fhx_cant_concentrate
trigger.match: You can't concentrate enough to cast 'incomplete healing'\.

muclient.script:
-- FHX plugin -- Author: Eric -- -- "fhx" self-heals (c incomp) - paced by heal-tick lines -- "fhx <player>" heals another player - paced by heal-tick lines -- "fhx low" heals lowest-HP group member in the room -- "fhx stop" stops immediately -- "hx" / "hx <player>" / "hx low" - same targeting, but ONE cast only -- "fhx help" shows the help screen
require "gmcphelper"
local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
-- ---- tunables ---------------------------------------------------------- -- Both self-heal and healing-others use the SAME pacing: cast, wait for the -- heal-tick line, then resend after FHX_CAST_DELAY. The watchdog stops things -- if no heal-tick is seen within FHX_WATCHDOG seconds. local FHX_CAST_DELAY = 1 -- pause after each heal-tick before resending local FHX_WATCHDOG = 10 -- stop if no heal-tick seen within this long local FHX_ONESHOT_TO = 8 -- give up waiting for a single 'hx' cast to land local FHX_QUEUE_MAX = 20 -- most items one command may queue at once local FHX_AUTO_MAX = 3 -- auto-heal won't push the queue past this FHX_AUTO_CHAIN = 3 -- most casts auto sends after one fight -- ('fhx burst <n>') -- A setting: 'fhx cooldown <n>'. Raise it to make auto engage less often -- over a long session. FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN = 12 -- seconds before auto may start another run -- Both of these are settings, changed in game with 'fhx thresh <n>' and -- 'fhx leaderthresh <n>' and remembered between sessions. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS = 4000 -- 'low' ignores anyone missing less than this FHX_LEADER_LOSS = 4000 -- 'auto leader' waits for the leader to be missing -- more than this many HP local SENDTO_SCRIPT = 12 -- "execute as script" send-to code
-- Diagnostics: flip to true to print [FHX dbg] lines while troubleshooting. -- ---- where settings live ----------------------------------------------- -- MUSHclient's own SetVariable storage is lost when the plugin is -- reinstalled by hand rather than reloaded, which is how these settings -- kept resetting. Keep them in a file next to the plugin instead. -- GetPluginInfo(id, 6) is the plugin FILE path, not its folder, so the -- filename has to be stripped off. local pluginFile = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 6) or "" local pluginDir = pluginFile:match ("^(.*[\\/])") or "" local settingsFile = pluginDir .. "FHX.dat"
local FHX_DEBUG = false local function dbg (s) if FHX_DEBUG then ColourNote ("yellow", "", "[FHX dbg] " .. s) end end
-- ---- colour helper (renders @x### and @-letter codes as a Note) -------- local function xterm_to_hex (n) n = tonumber (n) if not n then return "#aaaaaa" end if n < 16 then local base = {[0]="#000000","#800000","#008000","#808000","#000080", "#800080","#008080","#c0c0c0","#808080","#ff0000","#00ff00", "#ffff00","#0000ff","#ff00ff","#00ffff","#ffffff"} return base[n] or "#aaaaaa" elseif n >= 232 then local g = (n - 232) * 10 + 8 return string.format ("#%02x%02x%02x", g, g, g) else n = n - 16 local r = math.floor (n / 36); n = n % 36 local g = math.floor (n / 6); local b = n % 6 local lvl = {[0]=0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255} return string.format ("#%02x%02x%02x", lvl[r], lvl[g], lvl[b]) end end
local letter = { k="#000000", r="#aa0000", g="#00aa00", y="#aa5500", b="#0000aa", m="#aa00aa", c="#00aaaa", w="#aaaaaa", K="#555555", R="#ff5555", G="#55ff55", Y="#ffff55", B="#5555ff", M="#ff55ff", C="#55ffff", W="#ffffff", }
-- Parse a string with @x### / @<letter> colour codes and print it as one line. function cnote (s) local colour = "#aaaaaa" local buf, i, n = "", 1, #s local function flush () if buf ~= "" then ColourTell (colour, "", buf); buf = "" end end while i <= n do local ch = s:sub (i, i) if ch == "@" then local nxt = s:sub (i + 1, i + 1) if nxt == "x" then local digits = s:sub (i + 2):match ("^%d%d?%d?") or "" flush (); colour = xterm_to_hex (digits); i = i + 2 + #digits elseif nxt == "@" then buf = buf .. "@"; i = i + 2 elseif nxt ~= "" then flush (); colour = letter[nxt] or "#aaaaaa"; i = i + 2 else buf = buf .. "@"; i = i + 1 end else buf = buf .. ch; i = i + 1 end end flush () Note ("") -- terminate the line end
local tag = "@x099[@WFHX@x099]:@w "
-- Routine commentary: casts going out, queue progress, auto's running -- chatter. Silent mode drops these. Everything printed with cnote instead -- stays: replies to what you typed, mode changes, and auto switching -- itself on or off. function qnote (s) if not silent_mode then cnote (s) end end
-- ---- saving and loading settings --------------------------------------- -- Rewritten in full whenever any setting changes. function SaveSettings () local names = {} for name in pairs (ignore_list) do names[#names + 1] = name end table.sort (names)
local f, err = io.open (settingsFile, "w") if not f then dbg ("could not write " .. settingsFile .. ": " .. tostring (err)) return end f:write ("-- FHX settings. Edit in game with the fhx commands.\n") f:write ("spell=" .. heal_spell .. "\n") f:write ("auto=" .. (auto_low and "1" or "0") .. "\n") f:write ("autoleader=" .. (auto_leader and "1" or "0") .. "\n") f:write ("autozone=" .. auto_zone .. "\n") f:write ("silent=" .. (silent_mode and "1" or "0") .. "\n") f:write ("thresh=" .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. "\n") f:write ("leaderthresh=" .. FHX_LEADER_LOSS .. "\n") f:write ("cooldown=" .. FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN .. "\n") f:write ("burst=" .. FHX_AUTO_CHAIN .. "\n") f:write ("ignore=" .. table.concat (names, ",") .. "\n") f:close () dbg ("settings written to " .. settingsFile) end
-- Returns false when there's no settings file yet, so the loader knows to -- fall back to the old plugin variables and write one. function LoadSettings () local f = io.open (settingsFile, "r") if not f then return false end
local got = {} for line in f:lines () do local k, v = line:match ("^(%w+)=(.*)$") if k then got[k] = v end end f:close ()
if got.spell then heal_spell = (got.spell == "regen") and "regen" or "incomp" end if got.auto then auto_low = (got.auto == "1") end if got.autoleader then auto_leader = (got.autoleader == "1") end if got.autozone then auto_zone = got.autozone end if got.silent then silent_mode = (got.silent == "1") end if tonumber (got.thresh) then FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS = tonumber (got.thresh) end if tonumber (got.leaderthresh) then FHX_LEADER_LOSS = tonumber (got.leaderthresh) end if tonumber (got.cooldown) then FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN = tonumber (got.cooldown) end if tonumber (got.burst) then FHX_AUTO_CHAIN = tonumber (got.burst) end
ignore_list = {} for name in (got.ignore or ""):gmatch ("[^,]+") do ignore_list[string.lower (name)] = true end return true end
-- One-off: pick up whatever was in the old SetVariable storage the first -- time this version runs, so nothing is lost on the upgrade. function MigrateOldSettings () heal_spell = (GetVariable ("heal_spell") == "regen") and "regen" or "incomp" auto_low = (GetVariable ("auto_low") == "1") auto_leader = (GetVariable ("auto_leader") == "1") auto_zone = GetVariable ("auto_zone") or "" silent_mode = (GetVariable ("silent") == "1") FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS = tonumber (GetVariable ("low_thresh")) or FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS FHX_LEADER_LOSS = tonumber (GetVariable ("leader_thresh")) or FHX_LEADER_LOSS ignore_list = {} for name in (GetVariable ("ignore_list") or ""):gmatch ("[^,]+") do ignore_list[string.lower (name)] = true end dbg ("migrated settings from plugin variables") SaveSettings () end
-- ---- state ------------------------------------------------------------- healing_active = false heal_spell = "incomp" -- "incomp" (c incomp) or "regen" (c regen) heal_mode = "self" -- "self" or "other" heal_target = "" heal_gen = 0 -- bumped on every start/stop to cancel stale resend timers heal_watch_id = 0 -- bumped on every watchdog re-arm so stale watchdogs are ignored heal_cast_count = 0
-- ---- queue ------------------------------------------------------------- -- Every fhx/hx command becomes an item here and they run strictly in order, -- one at a time. Items wait while you're in combat (or otherwise can't cast) -- and start on their own once you're free. -- item = { kind = "rep" | "one", mode = "self" | "low" | "name", name = "" } fhx_queue = {} queue_current = nil -- item running right now (re-queued if combat interrupts) oneshot_pending = false -- a single 'hx' cast is in flight oneshot_gen = 0 -- invalidates stale one-shot timeouts auto_low = false -- 'fhx auto': queue an 'hx low' when a fight ends auto_leader = false -- 'fhx auto leader': aim auto at the leader only auto_chain = false -- an auto run is in progress (keeps topping up) auto_casts = 0 -- casts made in this auto run, against FHX_AUTO_CHAIN auto_last_run = 0 -- when the last auto run started (cooldown) auto_skip = {} -- names the MUD called fully healed during this run auto_zone = "" -- area 'fhx auto' was switched on in; leaving it -- switches auto back off silent_mode = false -- 'fhx silent': hide the cast-by-cast lines last_state = nil -- previous char.status.state, to spot 8 -> not-8
-- names 'fhx low' will never pick, lower-cased name -> true. Persisted. ignore_list = {}
-- ---- spell selection --------------------------------------------------- -- Build the cast command for the currently-selected spell. With no target it -- casts on self ("c incomp" / "c regen"); with a target it appends the name. function SpellCmd (target) local sp = (heal_spell == "regen") and "regen" or "incomp" if target and target ~= "" then return "c " .. sp .. " " .. target end return "c " .. sp end
-- Human-readable spell name for the status/started lines. function SpellName () return (heal_spell == "regen") and "regeneration" or "incomplete healing" end
-- Toggle alias handler for 'fhx regen' / 'fhx incomp'. Persists the choice. function SetHealSpell (sp) heal_spell = (sp == "regen") and "regen" or "incomp" SaveSettings () cnote (tag .. "@x045spell set to @W" .. SpellName () .. "@x045 ('@W" .. SpellCmd () .. "@x045').") end
-- ====================================================================== -- WATCHDOG (shared by both modes): stop if no heal-tick seen in time -- ====================================================================== function ArmWatchdog () heal_watch_id = heal_watch_id + 1 DoAfterSpecial (FHX_WATCHDOG, "Watchdog(" .. heal_watch_id .. ")", SENDTO_SCRIPT) end
function Watchdog (id) id = tonumber (id) -- only the most-recently-armed watchdog is valid; earlier stacked ones are stale if healing_active and id == heal_watch_id then StopHealing ("watchdog - no heal in " .. FHX_WATCHDOG .. "s") end end
-- ====================================================================== -- SELF HEAL (paced by "You are X healed by your magic touch.") -- ====================================================================== function StartSelfHeal () heal_gen = heal_gen + 1 healing_active = true heal_mode = "self" heal_target = "" heal_cast_count = 1 qnote (tag .. "@x045self-heal started@w - sending '@W" .. SpellCmd () .. "@w'.") dbg ("self cast #1 -> '" .. SpellCmd () .. "'") ArmWatchdog () Send (SpellCmd ()) end
-- Fired by the "You are X healed by your magic touch." trigger function HealTick () if OneshotDone () then return end if healing_active and heal_mode == "self" then ArmWatchdog () DoAfterSpecial (FHX_CAST_DELAY, "SelfCast(" .. heal_gen .. ")", SENDTO_SCRIPT) end end
function SelfCast (gen) gen = tonumber (gen) if healing_active and heal_mode == "self" and gen == heal_gen then heal_cast_count = heal_cast_count + 1 dbg ("self cast #" .. heal_cast_count .. " -> '" .. SpellCmd () .. "'") Send (SpellCmd ()) end end
-- ====================================================================== -- HEAL ANOTHER PLAYER -- Paced exactly like self-heal, but off "<who> is X healed by your magic -- touch." for the current target. -- ====================================================================== function StartHealPlayer (who) who = tostring (who or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if who == "" then return end BeginOtherHeal (who) end
function BeginOtherHeal (name) heal_gen = heal_gen + 1 healing_active = true heal_mode = "other" heal_target = name heal_cast_count = 1 dbg ("BeginOtherHeal: target='" .. name .. "' gen=" .. heal_gen) qnote (tag .. "@x045healing @W" .. name .. "@x045 - casting '@W" .. SpellCmd (name) .. "@x045' until healed.") dbg ("cast #1 -> '" .. SpellCmd (name) .. "'") ArmWatchdog () Send (SpellCmd (name)) end
-- Fired by the "<who> is X healed by your magic touch." trigger function OtherHealTick (who) -- "<name> is ... healed by your magic touch." only ever appears from OUR cast, -- and we heal one target at a time, so any such line means our heal landed. -- We deliberately do NOT name-match: the game line is prefixed with the -- target's title ("Sqrrlchasr Sletch is ..."), and the user may target by a -- partial name ("zarg" -> "Zargulis"). if OneshotDone () then return end if healing_active and heal_mode == "other" then dbg ("heal-tick (" .. tostring (who) .. ") -> next cast in " .. FHX_CAST_DELAY .. "s") ArmWatchdog () DoAfterSpecial (FHX_CAST_DELAY, "OtherResend(" .. heal_gen .. ")", SENDTO_SCRIPT) end end
function OtherResend (gen) gen = tonumber (gen) if healing_active and heal_mode == "other" and gen == heal_gen then heal_cast_count = heal_cast_count + 1 dbg ("cast #" .. heal_cast_count .. " -> '" .. SpellCmd (heal_target) .. "'") Send (SpellCmd (heal_target)) end end
-- Fired by the "<who> is almost/already fully healed." triggers function OtherHealedStop (who, reason) -- Same reasoning as OtherHealTick: one active target, so any "is almost/already -- fully healed." line during a heal is our target. Don't name-match. if oneshot_pending or (healing_active and heal_mode == "other") then -- the target being topped up is a normal finish, so an auto run carries -- on to whoever is next StopHealing (tostring (who) .. " " .. reason, false, true) end end
-- ====================================================================== -- IGNORE LIST ('fhx low' will never pick these names) -- ====================================================================== function SaveIgnoreList () SaveSettings () end
function IgnoreAdd (who) who = tostring (who or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if who == "" then return end local key = string.lower (who) if ignore_list[key] then cnote (tag .. "@x045" .. who .. "@x099 is already on the ignore list.@w") return end ignore_list[key] = true SaveIgnoreList () cnote (tag .. "@x045" .. who .. "@x099 added to the ignore list - '@Wfhx low@x099' will never target them.@w") end
function IgnoreRemove (who) who = tostring (who or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if who == "" then return end local key = string.lower (who) if not ignore_list[key] then cnote (tag .. "@x045" .. who .. "@x099 is not on the ignore list.@w") return end ignore_list[key] = nil SaveIgnoreList () cnote (tag .. "@x045" .. who .. "@x099 removed from the ignore list.@w") end
function IgnoreClear () ignore_list = {} SaveIgnoreList () cnote (tag .. "@x045ignore list cleared.@w") end
function IgnoreList () local names = {} for name in pairs (ignore_list) do names[#names + 1] = name end table.sort (names) if #names == 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x045ignore list is empty.@w") else cnote (tag .. "@x045ignore list@x099 (" .. #names .. "): @W" .. table.concat (names, ", ")) end end
-- ====================================================================== -- HEAL LOWEST-HP GROUP MEMBER IN THE ROOM -- ====================================================================== function MyName () local base = gmcp ("char.base") if type (base) == "table" and base.name then return tostring (base.name) end return "" end
-- Your own HP as a 0-1 ratio, for when the group data doesn't list you -- (or you aren't grouped at all). nil if the GMCP data isn't there. -- Returns (ratio, hp_missing) for yourself, or nil. function SelfRatio () local v = gmcp ("char.vitals") local m = gmcp ("char.maxstats") local hp = (type (v) == "table") and tonumber (v.hp) or nil local mhp = (type (m) == "table") and tonumber (m.maxhp) or nil if hp and mhp and mhp > 0 then return hp / mhp, mhp - hp end return nil end
-- Aardwolf marks group members that are mobs (pet golems, charmed mobs, -- clan pets) with qs = 3 in the GMCP group data - see References/ -- gmcp-aardwolf.md. Players carry qs 0/1/2. A missing qs is treated as a -- player so we never over-filter on odd data. function IsGroupPet (info) return type (info) == "table" and tonumber (info.qs) == 3 end
-- If a typed name matches a pet in the group (in full or as a prefix, the -- way 'gol' matches 'Golem'), returns that pet's name, otherwise nil. function GroupPetNamed (typed) local g = gmcp ("group") if type (g) ~= "table" or type (g.members) ~= "table" then return nil end local key = string.lower (tostring (typed or "")) if key == "" then return nil end for _, m in ipairs (g.members) do if IsGroupPet (m.info) then local name = tostring (m.name or "") local lname = string.lower (name) if lname == key or lname:sub (1, #key) == key then return name end end end return nil end
-- Returns (name, is_me): the person in the room with the lowest HP ratio, -- counting only people missing more than FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS hp - a heal on -- someone barely scratched is mostly wasted. You are a candidate like -- anyone else - if you're the lowest one here, this returns your name with -- is_me true and the caller heals you instead of casting at someone. -- Returns nil when nobody here is hurt enough to bother with. -- 'skip' is an optional set of lower-cased names to leave out - an auto run -- uses it for people the MUD has already called fully healed, so it doesn't -- keep casting at someone incomplete healing can't help any further. function FindLowestGroupMember (skip) local myname = MyName () local mykey = string.lower (myname) local my_ratio, my_loss = nil, 0 local best, best_ratio = nil, 2
local g = gmcp ("group") if type (g) == "table" and type (g.members) == "table" then for _, m in ipairs (g.members) do local info = m.info if type (info) == "table" then local name = tostring (m.name or "") local here = tostring (info.here) == "1" local hp = tonumber (info.hp) local mhp = tonumber (info.mhp) local isme = string.lower (name) == mykey and mykey ~= "" local ignored = ignore_list[string.lower (name)] if IsGroupPet (info) then dbg (" skipping " .. name .. " (pet/mob, qs=3)") elseif skip and skip[string.lower (name)] then dbg (" skipping " .. name .. " (already topped up this run)") elseif ignored then dbg (" skipping " .. name .. " (on ignore list)") elseif hp and mhp and mhp > 0 then local ratio = hp / mhp local loss = mhp - hp if isme then my_ratio, my_loss = ratio, loss dbg (" candidate " .. name .. " (you): hp=" .. hp .. "/" .. mhp .. " (down " .. loss .. ")") elseif here then dbg (" candidate " .. name .. ": hp=" .. hp .. "/" .. mhp .. " (down " .. loss .. ")") if loss > FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS and ratio < best_ratio then best_ratio = ratio best = name elseif loss <= FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS then dbg (" ignoring " .. name .. " - only down " .. loss) end end end end end else dbg ("FindLowestGroupMember: no group data - considering only yourself") end
-- group data didn't list you (or there is none): fall back to your vitals if not my_ratio and not ignore_list[mykey] and not (skip and skip[mykey]) then my_ratio, my_loss = SelfRatio () if my_ratio then dbg (" candidate you (from vitals): down " .. (my_loss or 0)) end end
if my_ratio and (my_loss or 0) > FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS and my_ratio < best_ratio then return (myname ~= "" and myname or "you"), true end return best, false end
function StartHealLow () local target, is_me = FindLowestGroupMember () dbg ("fhx low picked: " .. (target or "nobody") .. (is_me and " (you)" or "")) if not target then cnote (tag .. "@x045nobody here is down @W" .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. "@x045 hp@w - including you.") return end if is_me then qnote (tag .. "@x045you're the lowest here@x099 - healing yourself.@w") StartSelfHeal () else BeginOtherHeal (target) end end
-- ====================================================================== -- ONE-SHOT CASTS ('hx') -- Mirrors the 'fhx' commands, but sends a single cast and stops there. -- These never set healing_active, so no pacing, watchdog or stop is involved. -- ====================================================================== function HealOnceSelf () dbg ("hx: one cast on self -> '" .. SpellCmd () .. "'") qnote (tag .. "@x045one cast on yourself@w - '@W" .. SpellCmd () .. "@w'.") ArmOneshot () Send (SpellCmd ()) end
function HealOncePlayer (who) who = tostring (who or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if who == "" then return end dbg ("hx: one cast on " .. who .. " -> '" .. SpellCmd (who) .. "'") qnote (tag .. "@x045one cast on @W" .. who .. "@x045 - '@W" .. SpellCmd (who) .. "@x045'.") ArmOneshot () Send (SpellCmd (who)) end
function HealOnceLow () local target, is_me = FindLowestGroupMember () dbg ("hx low picked: " .. (target or "nobody") .. (is_me and " (you)" or "")) if not target then cnote (tag .. "@x045nobody here is down @W" .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. "@x045 hp@w - including you.") return end if is_me then qnote (tag .. "@x045you're the lowest here@x099 - healing yourself.@w") HealOnceSelf () else HealOncePlayer (target) end end
-- A single cast has no heal-tick pacing of its own, so we mark one as "in -- flight" and let the normal heal-tick / stop triggers close it out. The -- timeout is the backstop for a cast that produces no line we recognise. function ArmOneshot () oneshot_pending = true oneshot_gen = oneshot_gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial (FHX_ONESHOT_TO, "OneshotTimeout(" .. oneshot_gen .. ")", SENDTO_SCRIPT) end
-- Called from the heal-tick triggers. Returns true if it closed a one-shot. function OneshotDone () if not oneshot_pending then return false end dbg ("one-shot landed -> next queue item in " .. FHX_CAST_DELAY .. "s") oneshot_pending = false oneshot_gen = oneshot_gen + 1 queue_current = nil DoAfterSpecial (FHX_CAST_DELAY, "PumpQueue()", SENDTO_SCRIPT) return true end
function OneshotTimeout (gen) gen = tonumber (gen) if oneshot_pending and gen == oneshot_gen then dbg ("one-shot timed out after " .. FHX_ONESHOT_TO .. "s -> moving on") oneshot_pending = false queue_current = nil PumpQueue () end end
-- ====================================================================== -- QUEUE -- ======================================================================
-- char.status.state values we refuse to cast in. 3 (active), 4 (afk), -- 11 (resting/sitting) and 12 (running) are all treated as castable. local HOLD_STATES = { [1] = true, [2] = true, [5] = true, [6] = true, [7] = true, [8] = true, [9] = true } local HOLD_WHY = { [1] = "not in the game", [2] = "not in the game", [5] = "in the note editor", [6] = "in build mode", [7] = "at a pager prompt", [8] = "in combat", [9] = "asleep" }
function CharState () local st = gmcp ("char.status") if type (st) ~= "table" then return nil end return tonumber (st.state) end
-- No GMCP status at all -> assume we can cast, rather than block forever. function FHXReady () local s = CharState () if not s then return true end return not HOLD_STATES[s] end
function WhyNotReady () local s = CharState () return (s and HOLD_WHY[s]) or "busy" end
function Busy () return healing_active or oneshot_pending end
-- Words that belong to fhx's own commands. The 'fhx <player>' alias accepts -- any word, so without this an unknown or mistyped subcommand - or one from -- a newer version than the loaded plugin - is read as a player name, and the -- number after it as a repeat count. 'fhx yield 10' once queued ten casts at -- a player called "yield". Never again. local RESERVED = {} for w in ([[help stop regen incomp low queue q auto leader silent time thresh leaderthresh yield cooldown burst ignore on off add remove del delete list clear]]):gmatch ("%a+") do RESERVED[w] = true end
function ItemLabel (item) local cmd = (item.kind == "one") and "hx" or "fhx" if item.mode == "self" then return cmd .. " (self)" end if item.mode == "low" then return cmd .. " low" end return cmd .. " " .. item.name end
-- Every alias lands here. The item only runs now if nothing else is running -- and we're allowed to cast; otherwise it waits its turn. function Request (kind, mode, name, count) name = tostring (name or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if mode == "name" and name == "" then return end
-- a command word, not a person: say so instead of casting at it if mode == "name" and RESERVED[string.lower (name)] then cnote (tag .. "@x045'@W" .. name .. "@x045' is one of my own command words, " .. "not a player - @Wnothing queued@x045.@w") cnote (tag .. "@x099If you expected that to do something, this plugin may be " .. "older than the command. '@Wfhx help@x099' lists what it knows.@w") return end
-- don't waste casts on a pet golem / charmed mob, even if named directly if mode == "name" then local pet = GroupPetNamed (name) if pet then cnote (tag .. "@x045" .. pet .. "@x099 is a pet, not a player - not healing it.@w") return end end
count = tonumber (count) or 1 if count < 1 then count = 1 end if count > FHX_QUEUE_MAX then cnote (tag .. "@x045that asked for @W" .. count .. "@x045 casts - capping at @W" .. FHX_QUEUE_MAX .. "@x045. '@Wfhx stop@x045' clears the queue.@w") count = FHX_QUEUE_MAX end
local item = { kind = kind, mode = mode, name = name } local waiting = Busy () or not FHXReady ()
for i = 1, count do fhx_queue[#fhx_queue + 1] = { kind = kind, mode = mode, name = name } end dbg ("queued " .. count .. "x " .. ItemLabel (item) .. " (queue=" .. #fhx_queue .. ", busy=" .. tostring (Busy ()) .. ", ready=" .. tostring (FHXReady ()) .. ")")
if waiting then local why = Busy () and "busy healing" or WhyNotReady () cnote (tag .. "@x045queued @W" .. count .. "x " .. ItemLabel (item) .. "@x045 - @W" .. why .. "@x045. @W" .. #fhx_queue .. "@x045 waiting.@w") elseif count > 1 then cnote (tag .. "@x045queued @W" .. count .. "x " .. ItemLabel (item) .. "@x045.@w") end
PumpQueue () end
-- Start the next item, if there is one and we're free to send it. function PumpQueue () if Busy () then return end queue_current = nil -- an auto run refills the queue as fast as it empties, until it's done if #fhx_queue == 0 and auto_chain then AutoTopUp () end if #fhx_queue == 0 then return end if not FHXReady () then dbg ("queue held (" .. WhyNotReady () .. "), " .. #fhx_queue .. " waiting") return end local item = table.remove (fhx_queue, 1) queue_current = item RunItem (item) end
-- 'low' is resolved HERE, not when the command was typed, so a queue of -- 'hx low' items re-picks the lowest player before each cast. function RunItem (item) local target = nil local is_me = (item.mode == "self")
if item.mode == "low" then target, is_me = FindLowestGroupMember () dbg ("running " .. ItemLabel (item) .. " -> " .. (target or "nobody") .. (is_me and " (you)" or "")) if not target then -- item.quiet already keeps auto's own items silent, so anything -- reaching here was typed and deserves an answer even in silent mode if not item.quiet then cnote (tag .. "@x045nobody here is down @W" .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. "@x045 hp - skipping @W" .. ItemLabel (item) .. "@x045.@w") end queue_current = nil DoAfterSpecial (FHX_CAST_DELAY, "PumpQueue()", SENDTO_SCRIPT) return end if is_me then qnote (tag .. "@x045you're the lowest here@x099 - healing yourself.@w") end elseif item.mode == "name" then target = item.name end item.resolved = target or item.name -- who this cast actually went to
if item.kind == "rep" then if is_me then StartSelfHeal () else BeginOtherHeal (target) end else if is_me then HealOnceSelf () else HealOncePlayer (target) end end end
-- ====================================================================== -- THRESHOLD SETTINGS -- fhx thresh <n> how much HP someone must be missing before -- 'low' (and auto) will consider them -- fhx leaderthresh <n> the same bar for 'auto leader' -- Either with no number just reports the current value. 0 means "any -- damage at all". Both are remembered between sessions. -- ====================================================================== function SetBurst (n) n = tonumber (tostring (n or ""):match ("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") or "") if not n then cnote (tag .. "@x045auto sends at most @W" .. FHX_AUTO_CHAIN .. "@x045 cast(s) per fight. '@Wfhx burst <number>@x045' to change it.@w") return end if n < 1 then n = 1 end FHX_AUTO_CHAIN = n SaveSettings () cnote (tag .. "@x048auto now sends at most @W" .. n .. "@x048 cast(s) after each fight@x045, one at a time.@w") end
function SetCooldown (n) n = tonumber (tostring (n or ""):match ("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") or "") if not n then cnote (tag .. "@x045auto waits @W" .. FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN .. "@x045s between runs. '@Wfhx cooldown <seconds>@x045' to change it.@w") return end FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN = n SaveSettings () cnote (tag .. "@x048auto now waits @W" .. n .. "@x048s between runs@x045 - " .. "raise this to have it heal less often over a long session.@w") end
function SetLowThresh (n) n = tonumber (tostring (n or ""):match ("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") or "") if not n then cnote (tag .. "@x045player threshold: @W" .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. "@x045 hp missing. '@Wfhx thresh <number>@x045' to change it.@w") return end FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS = n SaveSettings () if n == 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x048player threshold cleared@x045 - '@Wlow@x045' will heal " .. "anyone missing any hp at all.@w") else cnote (tag .. "@x048player threshold set to @W" .. n .. "@x048 hp@x045 - '@Wlow@x045'" .. " ignores anyone hurt less than that.@w") end end
function SetLeaderThresh (n) n = tonumber (tostring (n or ""):match ("^%s*(%d+)%s*$") or "") if not n then cnote (tag .. "@x045leader threshold: @W" .. FHX_LEADER_LOSS .. "@x045 hp missing. '@Wfhx leaderthresh <number>@x045' to change it.@w") return end FHX_LEADER_LOSS = n SaveSettings () if n == 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x048leader threshold cleared@x045 - '@Wauto leader@x045' will heal " .. "the leader whenever they're hurt.@w") else cnote (tag .. "@x048leader threshold set to @W" .. n .. "@x048 hp@x045 - '@Wauto leader@x045'" .. " waits until the leader is down that much.@w") end end
-- ====================================================================== -- AUTO MODE ('fhx auto'): one 'hx low' each time a fight ends -- ====================================================================== -- Areas that count as one place for the auto anchor, so crossing between -- them doesn't switch auto off. These are GMCP room.info 'zone' keywords, -- taken from the mapper's area list: 'titan' is The Titans' Keep and -- 'transcend' is Transcendence. local ZONE_GROUPS = { titan = "titan+transcend", transcend = "titan+transcend", }
-- The area keyword from GMCP room.info ("zoo", "emerald", ...). Empty when -- there's no room data yet. function CurrentZone () local r = gmcp ("room.info") if type (r) ~= "table" then return "" end return tostring (r.zone or "") end
-- Called on every room.info. Auto is tied to the area it was switched on -- in, so stepping outside that area turns it off rather than letting it -- follow you around. function CheckAutoZone () if not auto_low then return end local zone = CurrentZone () if zone == "" then return end -- no room data - don't act on it
if auto_zone == "" then -- didn't know the area at toggle time auto_zone = zone SaveSettings () dbg ("auto: anchored to area '" .. zone .. "'") return end
if zone ~= auto_zone then -- linked areas: move the anchor along instead of switching off local from, to = ZONE_GROUPS[auto_zone], ZONE_GROUPS[zone] if from and from == to then dbg ("auto: '" .. auto_zone .. "' -> '" .. zone .. "' is the same group") auto_zone = zone SaveSettings () qnote (tag .. "@x099auto stays on - @W" .. zone .. "@x099 counts as the same place.@w") return end dbg ("auto: left '" .. auto_zone .. "' for '" .. zone .. "' - switching off") auto_low = false auto_chain = false cnote (tag .. "@x045auto-heal @Woff@x045 - you left @W" .. auto_zone .. "@x045. '@Wfhx auto@x045' to start it up here.@w") auto_zone = "" SaveSettings () end end
function SetSilent (word) word = string.lower (tostring (word or "")) if word == "on" then silent_mode = true elseif word == "off" then silent_mode = false else silent_mode = not silent_mode end SaveSettings () if silent_mode then cnote (tag .. "@x048silent mode on@x045 - cast-by-cast lines are hidden. " .. "Settings and auto starting/stopping still show.@w") else cnote (tag .. "@x045silent mode @Woff@x045 - everything shows again.@w") end end
function SetAutoLow (word) word = string.lower (tostring (word or "")) if word == "on" then auto_low = true elseif word == "off" then auto_low = false else auto_low = not auto_low -- bare 'fhx auto' toggles end if not auto_low then auto_chain = false end auto_zone = auto_low and CurrentZone () or "" SaveSettings () if auto_low then local who = auto_leader and ("the @Wgroup leader@x045 (down @W" .. FHX_LEADER_LOSS .. "@x045 hp)") or "whoever is lowest" cnote (tag .. "@x048auto-heal on@x045 - " .. who .. " after every fight, at most @W" .. FHX_AUTO_CHAIN .. "@x045 cast(s) each time.@w") if auto_zone ~= "" then cnote (tag .. "@x099tied to @W" .. auto_zone .. "@x099 - leaving the area switches it off.@w") end else cnote (tag .. "@x045auto-heal @Woff@x045.@w") end end
function SetAutoLeader (word) word = string.lower (tostring (word or "")) if word == "on" then auto_leader = true elseif word == "off" then auto_leader = false else auto_leader = not auto_leader end SaveSettings () if auto_leader then cnote (tag .. "@x048auto targets the group leader@x045 - only once they're " .. "down more than @W" .. FHX_LEADER_LOSS .. "@x045 hp.@w") else cnote (tag .. "@x045auto is back to healing whoever is @Wlowest@x045.@w") end if not auto_low then cnote (tag .. "@x099auto-heal itself is off - '@Wfhx auto on@x099' to start it.@w") end end
-- Returns (name, hp_missing, here, is_me) for the group leader, or nil if -- there's no group data, no leader field, or the leader isn't a player. function LeaderStatus () local g = gmcp ("group") if type (g) ~= "table" or type (g.members) ~= "table" then return nil end local lname = tostring (g.leader or "") if lname == "" then return nil end local key = string.lower (lname) for _, m in ipairs (g.members) do if string.lower (tostring (m.name or "")) == key then local info = m.info if type (info) ~= "table" or IsGroupPet (info) then return nil end local hp, mhp = tonumber (info.hp), tonumber (info.mhp) if not hp or not mhp then return nil end return lname, mhp - hp, tostring (info.here) == "1", key == string.lower (MyName ()) end end return nil end
-- 'auto leader' variant: heal the leader, and only once they're properly -- hurt. Silent when there's nothing to do - this runs after every fight. -- Each of the two AutoQueue* functions adds at most one cast and returns -- true if it did. Returning false is how an auto run knows it's finished. function AutoQueueLeader () local name, loss, here, is_me = LeaderStatus () if not name then dbg ("auto/leader: no leader in the group data") return false end if ignore_list[string.lower (name)] then dbg ("auto/leader: " .. name .. " is on the ignore list") return false end if not here and not is_me then dbg ("auto/leader: " .. name .. " isn't in the room") return false end if loss <= FHX_LEADER_LOSS then dbg ("auto/leader: " .. name .. " down " .. loss .. " - at or under the bar") return false end if auto_skip[string.lower (name)] then dbg ("auto/leader: " .. name .. " is already as healed as they'll get") return false end local item = { kind = "one", mode = (is_me and "self" or "name"), name = name, quiet = true } fhx_queue[#fhx_queue + 1] = item qnote (tag .. "@x048auto@x045: queued @W" .. ItemLabel (item) .. "@x045 - leader is down @W" .. loss .. "@x045 hp.@w") return true end
function AutoQueueLowest () local target = FindLowestGroupMember (auto_skip) if not target then dbg ("auto: nobody past the " .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. " hp bar") return false end fhx_queue[#fhx_queue + 1] = { kind = "one", mode = "low", name = "", quiet = true } qnote (tag .. "@x048auto@x045: queued @Whx low@x045 - @W" .. target .. "@x045 is next.@w") return true end
-- Called when combat ends. Adds a single 'hx low', but never pushes the -- queue past FHX_AUTO_MAX - what you type by hand is not capped. Stays -- quiet when nobody needs healing, so a clean fight prints nothing. -- Starts an auto run when a fight ends. The run keeps queueing casts, one -- at a time, until nobody is past the threshold any more. function AutoQueueLow () local held, why = AutoHeldBack () if held then dbg ("auto: not starting a run - " .. why) return end auto_last_run = os.time () auto_chain = true auto_casts = 0 auto_skip = {} AutoTopUp () end
-- Adds the next cast of the current auto run, or ends the run when there's -- nothing left worth healing. Called again after every cast completes. function AutoTopUp () if not auto_low or not auto_chain then return end -- never add while something is still waiting: auto stays at most one -- command deep, so it can't put you behind a pile of its own casts if #fhx_queue > 0 then dbg ("auto: " .. #fhx_queue .. " still waiting - not adding") return end if auto_casts >= FHX_AUTO_CHAIN then dbg ("auto: burst of " .. auto_casts .. " done for this fight") auto_chain = false return end
local queued if auto_leader then queued = AutoQueueLeader () else queued = AutoQueueLowest () end
if queued then auto_casts = auto_casts + 1 else if auto_casts > 0 then local what = auto_leader and "the leader is topped up" or "everyone here is topped up" qnote (tag .. "@x048auto done@x045 - " .. what .. " after @W" .. auto_casts .. "@x045 cast(s).@w") end auto_chain = false end end
-- Anything other than a heal finishing normally ends the run: no point -- casting again when we're out of mana or the fight restarted. function EndAutoChain (why) if auto_chain then dbg ("auto: run ended (" .. why .. ")") auto_chain = false if auto_casts > 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x045auto stopped - @W" .. why .. "@x045. It picks back up after the next fight.@w") end end end
function QueueShow () if queue_current and Busy () then cnote (tag .. "@x045running now: @W" .. ItemLabel (queue_current)) end if #fhx_queue == 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x045nothing waiting in the queue.@w") else local parts = {} for i, item in ipairs (fhx_queue) do parts[#parts + 1] = i .. ". " .. ItemLabel (item) end cnote (tag .. "@x045waiting@x099 (" .. #fhx_queue .. "): @W" .. table.concat (parts, " ")) end if not FHXReady () then cnote (tag .. "@x099held for now - you're @W" .. WhyNotReady () .. "@x099.@w") end if silent_mode then cnote (tag .. "@x099silent mode is on.@w") end if auto_low then cnote (tag .. "@x099heals at @W" .. FHX_LOW_MIN_LOSS .. "@x099 hp down, at most @W" .. FHX_AUTO_CHAIN .. "@x099 cast(s) per fight, @W" .. FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN .. "@x099s between runs.@w") end if auto_low and auto_zone ~= "" then cnote (tag .. "@x099auto is tied to @W" .. auto_zone .. "@x099.@w") end if auto_low then if auto_leader then cnote (tag .. "@x048auto-heal is on@x099 - the @Wgroup leader@x099 after each " .. "fight, once they're down @W" .. FHX_LEADER_LOSS .. "@x099 hp.@w") else cnote (tag .. "@x048auto-heal is on@x099 - one '@Whx low@x099' after each fight.@w") end end end
-- 'fhx stop' is the one off switch: it stops whatever is casting and -- empties the queue. There is no separate queue-clear command. function StopAll () local n = #fhx_queue fhx_queue = {} queue_current = nil auto_chain = false if Busy () then StopHealing ("manual stop") elseif n == 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x045nothing is healing and the queue is empty.@w") end if n > 0 then cnote (tag .. "@x045queue emptied@x099 (" .. n .. " item(s) dropped)@w.") end if auto_low then cnote (tag .. "@x099auto-heal is still on - '@Wfhx auto off@x099' to stop that too.@w") end end
-- ====================================================================== -- STOP -- ====================================================================== -- pause=true means "combat interrupted us": the item goes back to the front -- of the queue instead of being dropped, and the queue does not advance. function StopHealing (reason, pause, ok) local had_repeat = healing_active local had_oneshot = oneshot_pending if not had_repeat and not had_oneshot then return end
local what = "single cast" if had_repeat then healing_active = false heal_gen = heal_gen + 1 -- invalidate any pending timers what = (heal_mode == "other" and heal_target ~= "") and ("healing " .. heal_target) or "self-heal" end if had_oneshot then oneshot_pending = false oneshot_gen = oneshot_gen + 1 end -- The MUD saying almost/already fully healed (or wasting the magic) means -- this target is as topped up as incomplete healing can get them. Take -- them out of the auto run so it moves on instead of casting at them again. if ok and auto_chain and queue_current and queue_current.resolved then local done = string.lower (tostring (queue_current.resolved)) if done ~= "" then auto_skip[done] = true dbg ("auto: " .. queue_current.resolved .. " is done for this run") end end
dbg ("StopHealing: reason='" .. reason .. "' after " .. heal_cast_count .. " cast(s)") if had_oneshot and not had_repeat and not pause then -- a single cast that simply landed: just report what happened qnote (tag .. "@x045" .. reason .. ".@w") else qnote (tag .. "@x045" .. (pause and "paused" or "stopped") .. "@w @x099(" .. what .. ")@w - @W" .. reason .. ".") end
if pause then EndAutoChain ("combat") if queue_current then table.insert (fhx_queue, 1, queue_current) end queue_current = nil if #fhx_queue > 0 then qnote (tag .. "@x099holding @W" .. #fhx_queue .. "@x099 item(s) until you're out of combat.@w") end else if not ok then EndAutoChain (reason) end queue_current = nil DoAfterSpecial (FHX_CAST_DELAY, "PumpQueue()", SENDTO_SCRIPT) end end
-- True while auto should sit this one out: the last run was too recent. function AutoHeldBack () if os.time () - auto_last_run < FHX_AUTO_COOLDOWN then return true, "cooling down" end return false end
-- ====================================================================== -- COMBAT DETECTION (stop healing when we enter a fight) -- ====================================================================== function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, name, text) if id ~= GMCP_ID then return end
if text == "room.info" then CheckAutoZone () return end
if text ~= "char.status" then return end local state = CharState () local prev = last_state last_state = state
-- entering combat pauses whatever is casting and holds the queue if state == 8 then if Busy () then dbg ("char.status state=8 -> pausing for combat") StopHealing ("entered combat", true) end return end
-- a fight just ended (8 -> anything else): top the group back up if auto_low and prev == 8 then dbg ("combat ended -> auto-heal check") AutoQueueLow () end
-- free again (fight over, left the pager/note editor, woke up): carry on if #fhx_queue > 0 and not Busy () and FHXReady () then dbg ("state=" .. tostring (state) .. " -> resuming queue (" .. #fhx_queue .. " waiting)") PumpQueue () end end
-- ====================================================================== -- WHERE IS THE CLIENT'S TIME GOING? ('fhx time') -- MUSHclient tracks scripting time per plugin - GetPluginInfo(id, 24) - so -- this answers "is FHX the thing making me lag?" with a number rather than -- a guess. The figures are totals since the client started. -- ====================================================================== function ShowPluginTime () local list = GetPluginList () if type (list) ~= "table" then cnote (tag .. "@x045couldn't read the plugin list.@w") return end
local myid, rows, total = GetPluginID (), {}, 0 for _, id in ipairs (list) do local secs = tonumber (GetPluginInfo (id, 24)) or 0 rows[#rows + 1] = { name = tostring (GetPluginInfo (id, 1) or id), secs = secs, me = (id == myid) } total = total + secs end table.sort (rows, function (a, b) return a.secs > b.secs end)
Note ("") cnote (tag .. "@x045scripting time since the client started@x099 - " .. #rows .. " plugins, @W" .. string.format ("%.1f", total) .. "s@x099 total@w") local shown = math.min (12, #rows) for i = 1, shown do local r = rows[i] local pct = (total > 0) and (r.secs / total * 100) or 0 cnote (string.format (" %s%2d. %-26s %8.2fs %5.1f%%%s", r.me and "@x048" or "@w", i, r.name:sub (1, 26), r.secs, pct, r.me and " @x099<- this plugin@w" or "")) end for i, r in ipairs (rows) do if r.me and i > shown then cnote (string.format (" @x048 %-26s %8.2fs @x099(ranked #%d)@w", r.name:sub (1, 26), r.secs, i)) end end Note ("") cnote ("@x099Big numbers here mean the client is busy running that plugin's script.") cnote ("@x099If your own commands feel slow but every number is small, the delay is") cnote ("@x099coming from the MUD or the connection, not from a plugin.@w") Note ("") end
-- ====================================================================== -- HELP -- ====================================================================== function ShowHelp () Note ("") cnote ("@x099===== @WFHX Help@x099 =====@w") cnote ("@x099Repeatedly casts incomplete healing until the target is healed,") cnote ("@x099you run low on mana, or you enter combat.@w") Note ("") cnote ("@x099Commands:@w") cnote (" @Wfhx@x045 @x099 self-heal (cast '@Wc incomp@x099' on yourself)") cnote (" @Wfhx <player>@x045 @x099 heal another player ('@Wc incomp <player>@x099')") cnote (" @Wfhx low@x045 @x099 heal whoever here is lowest on HP (you included)") cnote (" @x045-@x099 '@Wlow@x099' only counts people missing more than @W" ..
